from solution import max_len_sub


def test_issue_example_returns_five():
    """Check issue example 'max_len_sub([2,5,6,3,7,6,5,8],8)==5'."""
    assert max_len_sub([2, 5, 6, 3, 7, 6, 5, 8], 8) == 5  # 5 literal from issue


def test_issue_empty_returns_zero():
    """Check empty array has maximum subsequence length 0."""
    assert max_len_sub([], 0) == 0  # 0 elements => 0


def test_issue_single_returns_one():
    """Check single-element array has maximum subsequence length 1."""
    assert max_len_sub([42], 1) == 1  # 1 element => 1


def test_issue_single_negative_returns_one():
    """Check single-element array has maximum subsequence length 1."""
    assert max_len_sub([-7], 1) == 1  # 1 element => 1


def test_issue_nonempty_at_least_one():
    """Check non-empty array has maximum length at least 1."""
    result = max_len_sub([10, 20, 30], 3)
    assert result >= 1  # 1 = single-element minimum


def test_issue_result_at_most_n():
    """Check maximum length never exceeds n."""
    result = max_len_sub([10, 20, 30], 3)
    assert result <= 3  # 3 = n


def test_issue_two_elements_bounded():
    """Check two-element result lies between 1 and n."""
    result = max_len_sub([2, 5], 2)
    assert 1 <= result <= 2  # 1 = minimum, 2 = n


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Check documented rule that result is a length (int)."""
    result = max_len_sub([2, 5, 6, 3, 7, 6, 5, 8], 8)
    assert isinstance(result, int)  # int type => 1 = True for isinstance


def test_contract_input_not_mutated():
    """Check documented rule that input array is unchanged."""
    arr = [2, 5, 6, 3, 7, 6, 5, 8]
    max_len_sub(arr, 8)
    assert arr == [2, 5, 6, 3, 7, 6, 5, 8]  # 8 = unchanged length


def test_contract_repeatable():
    """Check documented rule that same input gives same length."""
    first = max_len_sub([2, 5, 6, 3, 7, 6, 5, 8], 8)
    second = max_len_sub([2, 5, 6, 3, 7, 6, 5, 8], 8)
    assert first == second == 5  # 5 = issue example value
